description:
"Shroud yourself in mist to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage taken from area attacks by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff38|r seconds.

While this effect is active, when you take damage from a direct area of effect attack you gain Major Expedition for |cffffff6|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. 

Each piece of Medium Armor worn increases the duration of this ability."
